info.title: TinyFish Browser API
info.description: Create remote browser sessions for direct Playwright/CDP control.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for authentication. Get your key from the API Keys page.

text.description: Extracted content (string for markdown/html, object for json). Null if extraction failed.

links.description: Extracted links (only if links=true in request)

image_links.description: Extracted image links (only if image_links=true in request)

iframe_links.description: Extracted <iframe src> URLs, absolute and deduplicated (only if iframe_links=true in request)

page_metadata.description: Page-head metadata (only if page_metadata=true in request): canonical, favicon, robots, generator, viewport, keywords, plus nested og/twitter/article objects keyed by tag suffix and remaining named meta tags under `other`. Tags that legitimately repeat (og:image, og:locale:alternate, article:tag, article:author) collect into arrays. Keys are omitted when the page does not declare them; the whole field is omitted when the page exposes none.

latency_ms.description: Fetch latency for this URL in milliseconds if available from tf-fetch

not_modified.description: Present and `true` only when the origin returned 304 Not Modified for your `if_none_match`/`if_modified_since`; omitted otherwise.

etag.description: The origin's current ETag validator, present only when the origin sent one and you set `include_etag_and_last_modified: true`; omitted otherwise. Store it and replay it as `if_none_match`.

last_modified.description: The origin's current Last-Modified validator, present only when the origin sent one and you set `include_etag_and_last_modified: true`; omitted otherwise. Store it and replay it as `if_modified_since`.

unmatched_selectors.description: Partial-miss report for `include_selectors`: the entries that matched no elements on this page, present only when some (but not all) entries matched — the result still carries the matched content. Omitted when every entry matched. A total miss is not a result at all: it is reported as a `selector_not_matched` entry in `errors[]`.

error.description: Error code describing the failure. Possible values: `target_http_error` (target server returned a non-2xx HTTP status other than 404/410 — see `status` field), `page_not_found` (target returned HTTP 404 or 410), `target_unreachable` (connection refused, TLS failure, or network error), `timeout` (request timed out), `proxy_error` (proxy tunnel failure), `bot_blocked` (bot-challenge page detected), `empty_content` (page loaded but no extractable text), `login_required` (target redirected to a login or account wall; the page is not served to anonymous sessions, so retrying without credentials will not help), `content_too_large` (document exceeds the 20MB size limit for generic documents — not retried in the browser; PDF and CSV have their own 50MB budgets), `invalid_url` (malformed URL or SSRF-blocked address), `invalid_redirect_url` (redirect target rejected before fetch), `conditional_unsupported` (conditional requests are supported on the fast path only; this URL requires browser rendering), `selector_not_matched` (no elements matching any `include_selectors` entry remained after `exclude_selectors` was applied — a total miss; carries `unmatched_selectors` and `candidate_selectors` retry hints. A partial miss is NOT an error: it is reported via the result's `unmatched_selectors`), `selector_unsupported` (`include_selectors`/`exclude_selectors` sent for a URL that resolves to a direct PDF/CSV download — no HTML to scope).

status.description: Upstream HTTP status code. Only present when `error` is `target_http_error` or `page_not_found`.

unmatched_selectors.description: The `include_selectors` entries that matched no elements on the fetched page. Only present when `error` is `selector_not_matched`.

candidate_selectors.description: Cheap retry hints (max 10), only present when `error` is `selector_not_matched`: landmark tags present on the page (e.g. `main`, `article`, `nav`) plus `#id` selectors of content-heavy elements. Retry the fetch with `include_selectors` drawn from this list.

items.description: A URL that failed to fetch

request_id.description: Request correlation ID, also returned as the X-Request-ID response header. Present only when errors is non-empty; include it when reporting failed URLs.

is_baseline.description: True for the first run; nothing to compare.

thumbnail_url.description: Thumbnail image URL, present only when include_thumbnail=true and a thumbnail is available

fetch.description: Fetched page content, present only when fetch param is supplied

fetch_error.description: Fetch error details when fetch was requested. Contains details on failure; may be null when fetching succeeds.

date.description: Publication date, present for news and some web results

publisher.description: Publisher name, present for news results when domain_type=news

authors.description: Author list, present for academic results when domain_type=research_paper

venue.description: Journal or conference name, present when domain_type=research_paper

pdf_url.description: PDF URL, present when domain_type=research_paper and a PDF is available

new_result_positions.description: Positions of results not seen in earlier runs

MonitorRun.description: Fetch result for Page Monitors, Search for Topic

post.description:
Creates a remote tf-browser session and returns CDP connection details. Connect to the browser via CDP WebSocket at `cdp_url`.

By default the session egresses through the TinyFish residential proxy in the US, pinned to one exit IP for the life of the session. Use `proxy_config` to pick another country (`country_code`, any ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), bring your own proxy (`type: "custom"`), or disable the proxy (`enabled: false`).

Use `timeout_seconds` to set a custom inactivity timeout (5–86400 seconds). If omitted, null, or greater than your plan maximum, the plan maximum is used (15 min on free tier, 60 min on paid).

url.description: Target URL the browser session will navigate to on startup. Bare domains (e.g. tinyfish.ai) are automatically prefixed with https://. If omitted, the browser starts at about:blank.

timeout_seconds.description: Inactivity timeout in seconds (5–86400). If omitted, null, or greater than your plan maximum, the plan maximum is used.

enabled.description: Route the session through a proxy. false means direct egress.

type.description: "tinyfish" uses the TinyFish residential proxy, pinned to one exit IP per session. "custom" routes through your own proxy — requires url.

country_code.description: Exit country for the TinyFish proxy (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Defaults to US.

url.description: Your HTTP or HTTPS proxy server URL. Required when type is "custom".

proxy_config.description: Proxy for the session. Omit to use the TinyFish proxy in the US.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this browser session.

cdp_url.description: WebSocket URL for browser connection. Pass this to Playwright's connect_over_cdp or any WebSocket-based CDP client.

base_url.description: HTTPS base URL for the session. Use to access session endpoints such as /pages.

schema.description: Browser session created successfully. Connect to the browser via cdp_url.
